wishes: Planner defaults (Pavel gave only the genre and title): cheerful 1950s suburban sitcom; candy-coloured retro gadgets, chrome and pastel-but-saturated colours; family-friendly comedy; no text on signs or screens; avoid objects already used in Love in the City or in the reference collection.

variants.concept: Home Sweet Home: the dream house and its gadgets

cards.name: Pop-up Toaster
cards.subject: a rounded chrome-and-cherry-red retro toaster with two slices of golden toast popping up
cards.unique_detail: a small heart toasted into one slice
cards.main_colors: cherry red and chrome, golden toast
cards.background: bright blue with radiating rays

cards.name: Retro TV
cards.subject: a 1950s wooden-cabinet television with rounded corners, short legs and a rabbit-ear antenna, its blank screen softly glowing
cards.unique_detail: two big round cream control knobs
cards.background: a polished wooden living-room floor in front of a smooth warm yellow wall
cards.why: The family TV is the heart of the sitcom home.

cards.name: Dream House

cards.background: a strip of green lawn and sidewalk at the bottom and a bright blue sky with soft clouds
cards.why: The picture-perfect home of the title.
